## Updraft 0.7.7

- **New: Shortcuts page.** One page lists every key combo in Updraft, with a search box. It flags two shortcuts that use the same keys, and "Go to setting" jumps straight to the right row. Off until you turn it on (Settings > App > "Shortcuts page (new)").
- **New: screen recording on the Mac.** Screen recording now works on the Mac too, with your mic and the computer's sound. While a recording runs, dictation starts instantly. Off until you turn it on.
- **Improved: Settings is easier to find your way around.** Settings now has 11 clear sections under group headings (Dictation, Capture, Look and feel, Connect, Data), clearer names for many settings, and a search box that looks through all of Settings. No setting changed its value.
